mapper.select: select DISTINCT a.plan_id, a.device_code, a.channel_code, a.stream_type, a.if_preset, a.chan_order, e.longitude, e.latitude, (case when length(IFNULL(dr.device_name, '')) = 0 then e.device_name else dr.device_name end ) deviceName, (case when length(IFNULL(dr.channel_name, '')) = 0 then d.channel_name else dr.channel_name end ) channelName from vm_reserve_plan_channel_t a join vm_reserve_plan_t b on a.plan_id = b.plan_id LEFT JOIN vm_order_devices c ON c.device_code = a.device_code and c.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND c.industry_code = b.industry_code left join vm_channel_info_t d on c.device_code = d.device_code AND d.channel_code = a.channel_code left join vm_device_info_t e on a.device_code = e.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t dr on dr.device_code = a.device_code and dr.delete_flag = '0' AND dr.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and dr.industry_code = b.industry_code AND dr.channel_code = a.channel_code where a.plan_id = #{planId} and a.delete_flag = 0 AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND c.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 ) ${param.dataScope}

select DISTINCT a.plan_id, a.device_code, a.channel_code, a.stream_type, a.if_preset, vp.preset_name as presetName, a.chan_order, e.longitude, e.latitude, (case when length(IFNULL(dr.device_name, '')) = 0 then e.device_name else dr.device_name end ) deviceName, (case when length(IFNULL(dr.channel_name, '')) = 0 then d.channel_name else dr.channel_name end ) channelName from vm_reserve_plan_channel_t a join vm_reserve_plan_t b on a.plan_id = b.plan_id LEFT JOIN vm_order_devices c ON c.device_code = a.device_code and c.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND c.industry_code = b.industry_code left join vm_channel_info_t d on c.device_code = d.device_code AND d.channel_code = a.channel_code left join vm_device_info_t e on a.device_code = e.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t dr on dr.device_code = a.device_code and dr.delete_flag = '0' AND dr.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and dr.industry_code = b.industry_code AND dr.channel_code = a.channel_code left join vm_video_preset vp on a.if_preset = vp.preset_id and vp.delete_flag = '0' where a.delete_flag = 0 AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND c.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 )
and a.plan_id in
#{planId}
${param.dataScope} ORDER BY CAST(a.chan_order AS UNSIGNED)
